caption: The same honest error checker scores 69.26 or 35.59 out of 100 in Arc Compiler Runtime, depending only on a return format that no instruction mentions. The agent completes a small compiler; hidden tests worth 33.67 points expect error reports as a list of {level, message}, while the starter code returns another format and nothing the agent can see says which is right. The fix documents the format in the task notes; the checker is unchanged, so the same code scores the same as before.
